name: Sonoda Tomari
source:
He is the son of the neighbor and a good friend. He has known the main character and Yuna since kindergarten.

He is a good student, but an erotic nerd. He is not good at sports. When he says something stupid, his glasses light up and he feels like he is blind.

translation:
邻居家的儿子，也是主人公的好朋友。从幼儿园起，他就认识主人公和由奈。

他学习很好，却是个色情宅。不擅长运动，说蠢话时眼镜会发光，让他觉得自己像瞎了一样。
